I'm disappointed because I love the rest of their products! If you have sensitive skin you may want to reconsider the scar gel. I love their dark spot treatment and it works great on my combo acne-prone skin. The smell is chemically but tolerable and the application is nice and smooth. I was excited and hopeful to try Differin Resurfacing Acne Scar Gel...as an adult who has struggled with acne of varying degrees of severity for my entire life, I have my fair share of mild scarring. And I am happy to report that Differin is making a difference, but patience is definitely required. After using it on my face and back, I feel like my scarring is fading compared to places I haven't been applying it (for reference). Obviously I've given up ever getting rid of acne altogether, it is relatively mild, in this my fourth decade of life, and I can say that the Differin definitely isn't causing breakouts. It isn't irritating on the skin, doesn't have an odor, moisturizes, and absorbs well. For me, this alone is half the battle for better, clearer skin. I apply twice a day, morning and evening, and fortunately it doesn't stain my clothing or pajamas, so it doesn't slow down my routine. It spreads easily, so it has lasted me quite a long time (longer than the size of the container suggests.) This product requires diligent use, and a marathon mindset...it isn't a magic, and you won't see improvement overnight. But results do come. Slowly, which can be hard, and frustrating. But I didn't get my scars overnight, so apart from surgery, I don't expect them to depart any quicker. I like how the Differin makes my skin feel, and I like how it's fading acne scars that I've grown very tired of seeing. I do recommend.

As I get older, scarring takes longer to heal or a lot of the time it becomes permanent.
